_metadata.purpose: Tier-3 full-collision incomplete-decoupling cross-code reference values for the future PR-T3D canonical promotion. All entries are at FLRW (Σ=0), CL2, η=6.104e-10, τ_n=878.4. Y_p is the primordial He-4 mass fraction; N_eff is the effective neutrino number including incomplete-decoupling heating.
_metadata.preflight_status: Numbers are sourced from the published references. The PR-T3B canonical milestone (ap_unified_preflight, publicly dispatchable as backend='jax_ap_unified_tier3') passes the canonical anisotropy + grid gates; the residual FLRW Mangano gap (~0.0095) is documented as the AP-form model approximation limit per PR-T3B-PF #15 scope reframing. Canonical-tier promotion remains gated on Option E (post-canonical, deferred). See docs/audit/PR-T3D_preflight.md, docs/audit/PR-T3B_jax_kernel_runtime.md, and tests/test_pr_t3d_ap_unified_dispatch.py for the full trail.

preflight_measurements._note: Per-mode FLRW measurements at the bounded preflight grids, captured via tests/test_pr_t3b_cross_mode_neff.py and tests/test_pr_t3b_ap_convergence.py. These are MEASURED values from the current preflight surface, not target values, included in the fixture so the canonical work has a reproducible baseline.

spectral_relaxation_preflight._note: AP-form spectral damping; closer to Mangano than jax_kernel; fails at larger grids due to max_steps budget.

ap_unified_preflight._canonical_milestone: PR-T3B canonical #1 (publicly dispatchable via canonical_forward_solver(backend='jax_ap_unified_tier3') after PR-T3D canonical #2). Combines spectral psi_target + projected damping decomposition + soft total-rate enforcement; achieves the canonical PR-T3D §5 anisotropy gate AND grid scaling, with the FLRW Mangano gap surfaced as flrw_mangano_gap_documented=0.0095.

_anisotropic_sweep_4_6._canonical_target: |N_eff spread across Sigma sweep| < 1e-3 (PR-T3D phase prompt §5)

_cl_ladder_flrw_4_6._note: Full CL0-CL3 ladder publicly dispatchable on the tier-3 surface (PR-T3 full CL envelope, see tests/test_pr_t3_full_cl_envelope.py). Y_p increases monotonically with CL (Born/+Coulomb+Sirlin/+finite-mass weak corrections); N_eff is CL-invariant at the AP-form FLRW value with the documented Mangano gap.

ap_unified_preflight._flrw_gap_origin: ap_form_model_approximation_limit (PR-T3B-PF #15 scope reframing; closing this requires Option E or research-grade IMEX/AP-Rosenbrock variant)
ap_unified_preflight._note: Canonical-track candidate; passes 2 of 3 canonical gates (anisotropy + grid) at every CL. Y_p at CL2/CL3 already lands within ~5e-5 / ~5e-4 of LASAGNA / PRIMAT-AC2024. The remaining FLRW N_eff gap is the documented AP-form model fidelity limit, not a numerical defect.

projected_physical_preflight._note: AP-form projected source+damping; FULLY GRID-CONVERGED. Spread < 3e-5 across grids vs ~1.3e-2 gap to Mangano. Calibration signal: residual gap is AP-form model approximation, not quadrature resolution.

jax_kernel_preflight._note: Full Hannestad-Madsen JAX kernel; anti-heating bug from T_e=T_ν approx (q-grid remap fix exposes stiff manifold; canonical needs IMEX/AP hybrid).

jax_kernel_remap_preconditioned_prefligh._note: Electron-frame remapped kernel RHS with a modified collision-bank Jacobian preconditioner. This is a Rodas5P stiffness diagnostic, not a canonical calibration: it reaches the full ODE handoff and has a bounded tolerance envelope, but the N_q=6/8/10 spread shows it is not grid-converged and should not be tuned to N_eff=3.044 without a fuller non-QKE collision calibration.

collisionless_tier1._note: Sanity floor: no collision source; close to standard adiabatic 4/11 ratio.

anisotropic_sweep_projected_physical._canonical_target: |N_eff spread across Sigma sweep| < 1e-3 (PR-T3D phase prompt §5)
anisotropic_sweep_projected_physical._note: Anisotropic N_eff drops monotonically with Sigma_H by 0.54 across the bounded sweep -- 100x above canonical target. AP-form damping does not track shear-driven transport asymmetry. Canonical PR-T3B fix: species-dependent damping coefficients tuned against linearised-PSTF reference, or shear-aware equilibration projections.

mangano_2005.note: Y_p not quoted to the same precision in the original; N_eff = 3.044 is the SM benchmark for the FLRW baseline.
